context.body: The prophet explicitly compares the promise to the waters of Noah and says mountains may depart while steadfast love and covenant of peace will not be removed.

observations.body: Noah’s covenant is not merely remembered; it becomes a comparison for another promise.
observations.label: Noah becomes a comparison for covenant peace: textual observation

observations.body: The passage keeps Steadfast love · covenant of peace visible within its covenant claim.

payload.posture: Read Isaiah 54:9–10 as its own prophetic horizons covenant setting before carrying its language into another source.
payload.tension: The source places Mountains move · covenant peace remains inside this covenant setting without turning it into a definition for every covenant passage.
